items.title: Houthi attacks raise safety fears among Nepali workers in Saudi Arabia
items.blurb: Around 400,000 Nepalis work in Saudi Arabia. Recent attacks have raised fresh concerns about their safety as workers call for better protection and emergency arrangements.

items.title: Two Japanese climbers found dead on Gangapurna
items.blurb: Hidesuke Taneishi, 40, and Tetsu Hashimoto, 25, went missing at around 7,050 metres while climbing the 7,455-metre peak in Manang.

items.title: Bhandari calls for long-term climate support for vulnerable countries
items.blurb: Nepal’s former president Bidya Devi Bhandari urges Himalayan nations to cooperate on glacier monitoring and disaster preparedness, while calling for long-term international support for climate-vulnerable countries.

items.title: Dashain brings fewer domestic tourists to Sauraha
items.blurb: Hoteliers say fears of renewed road closures have kept visitors away, although international tourists are gradually returning after flood-related cancellations.

items.title: They never fought in the decade-long ‘People’s War’. They still bear its scars
items.blurb: Civilians injured or disabled during the conflict, despite having no affiliation with either side, say the state has excluded them from relief and compensation programmes.

items.title: Nepal takes government websites offline over critical PHP flaws
items.blurb: Emergency patching is underway after two vulnerabilities exposed systems worldwide to attacks that could allow hackers to run code on servers without logging in.

items.title: Earthquake of magnitude 7 strikes China’s Tibet, killing 16
items.blurb: The quake struck a sparsely populated, high-altitude area of northern Tibet, injuring 32 people and prompting rescue teams to mobilise.

items.title: Loss and damage fund approves $20 million for Nepal
items.blurb: The funding is intended to help flood-hit communities in the Bhotekoshi–Trishuli region recover and rebuild.
